name: Tinyauth
description: Tinyauth is an extremely simple Traefik forward auth proxy that adds a login screen to all of your apps that are using the Traefik reverse proxy. Tinyauth is configurable through environment variables and it is only 20MB in size.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: The URL of the Tinyauth instance.

variables.name: Users and Passwords
variables.description: A comma-separated list of users names and their bcrypt hashed passwords, in pattern 'user:hashed_password'

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal server port. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Address
variables.description: The internal address to bind to. Not recommended to change.

labels.name: Traefik - Rule
labels.description: Traefik rule. Change based on your domain.

labels.name: Traefik - Server Port
labels.description: Server port for Tinyauth. Change as needed.
